observations: Cancel primary mousedown default while preserving the compatibility event for outside-menu listeners; explicit focus restores keyboard resize.
Only primary non-Control pointer begins dragging. Moves and termination are bound to its ID; a missing primary button also terminates.
No global user-select change. Axis/invert/bounds and existing keyboard stepping remain.
Final tests assert an intervening other-pointer move, retained mouse-button end conditions and lost release. Six source mutations each fail corresponding tests.
